activePlan.objective: Fix two real, current CI failures found while driving development to green: a Windows-only chmod-mode test assertion, and The Crucible's own commit-message-length gate failing on the fix commit's own subject line.
steps: Confirm the Windows failure via job logs (438 !== 493, i.e. 0o666 vs 0o755) for windows-latest/22 and windows-latest/24; make the two exact-mode assertions in test/installGitHooks.test.js conditional on process.platform !== 'win32'.

Push the fix; discover a second, different failure: src/commit.js's CRUCIBLE_COMMIT_LONG_COMMIT_SUBJECT check failed on that same commit (79-character subject vs the 72-character cap), marked fixable:false / human-review-required.

Ask the owner how to proceed, since clearing it requires amending an already-pushed commit's message and force-pushing to the shared development branch - not something to do unilaterally. Owner approved amend-and-force-push.
Amend commit ee3eacd to a 52-character subject and force-push (ee3eacd...c6b1625).
At the owner's explicit follow-up instruction, raise the commit-subject-length cap in src/commit.js from 72 to 80 characters, then from 80 to 120 characters (a further explicit owner request).
Re-run the full local suite plus lint:workflows, docs:check, validate, and the three fast audits before pushing each cap change.

completed: Made the exact-0o755 assertions in test/installGitHooks.test.js platform-conditional (skipped on win32), since fs.chmodSync cannot set true POSIX executable bits on Windows/NTFS.

Amended and force-pushed commit ee3eacd -> c6b1625 to shorten its subject below the (then) 72-character commit-gate limit, with explicit owner approval - CRUCIBLE_COMMIT_LONG_COMMIT_SUBJECT is fixable:false by design, so this was never done unilaterally.
Raised src/commit.js's commit-subject-length cap from 72 to 80, then from 80 to 120 characters, per the owner's explicit, successive instructions.
verification: Full local suite passes 172/172 after each change.
lint:workflows, docs:check, validate, audit:clutter, audit:privacy, and audit:security all pass against the current staged snapshot.
No test hardcoded either old threshold, so no test needed updating for either cap change.
remaining: Push to development, then confirm Self-Test (including its precheck/commit-gate step) is green on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, and macos-latest for the new commit, plus AI handoff policy, AI conflict governance, and CodeQL.
No default-branch or repository-setting change involved; nothing further requires owner authorization.
